events.title: Steve Jobs returns to Apple as interim CEO
events.summary: Apple's board named Steve Jobs interim CEO on July 9, 1997 after acquiring NeXT — beginning Apple's turnaround.
events.about: Jobs killed failing product lines, introduced the iMac, and steered Apple toward design-led consumer hardware and developer-friendly macOS. The return set up the iPod, iPhone, and App Store ecosystem that reshaped mobile computing.

narrative.whyChosen: Jobs' return is the pivot point for modern Apple as a platform company.
narrative.whyImportant: It reunited hardware, software, and design under one product vision.
narrative.problemSolved: Apple was near bankruptcy with fragmented products and no clear OS strategy.

sources.title: Apple — Apple buys NeXT, Jobs returns (December 1997 context; interim CEO July 1997)
